fields.name: minWeight
docs: The lowest weight awarded for staking, measured as a fraction of `1 / SCALE_FACTOR_BASE`.
For instance:
* `min_weight = 1 x SCALE_FACTOR_BASE` signifies a minimum multiplier of 1x for min staking duration
* `min_weight = 2 x SCALE_FACTOR_BASE` indicates a minimum multiplier of 2x for min staking duration

fields.name: maxWeight
docs: The highest weight awarded for staking, measured as a fraction of `1 / SCALE_FACTOR_BASE`.
For instance:
* `max_weight = 1 x SCALE_FACTOR_BASE` signifies a max multiplier of 1x for max staking duration
* `max_weight = 2 x SCALE_FACTOR_BASE` indicates a max multiplier of 2x for max staking duration

fields.name: minDuration
docs: Min Duration of stake in seconds

fields.name: maxDuration
docs: Max Duration of stake in seconds, the more duration, the more weight the stake has

fields.name: permissionless
docs: Whether anyone can add Reward Pools or just admin

fields.name: vault
docs: Escrow Account that stores staked tokens

fields.name: stakeMint
docs: Stake Mint, will be returned in exchange for stake tokens

fields.name: totalStake
docs: Total number of Staked tokens

fields.name: totalEffectiveStake
docs: Total staked tokens accounting for each stake weight, does not equal `total_stake`,
represents a sum of effective stake multiplied by 10^9 for precision

fields.name: freezeStakeMint
docs: Whether we should freeze stake mint token accounts

fields.name: unstakePeriod
docs: Period for unstaking, if set unstake at first should be requested, and the real unstake can only happen after this period

fields.name: isTotalStakeCapped
docs: Whether amount of total staked tokens is limited by `remaining_total_stake` - stored as separate flag to not deal with `Option`

fields.name: remainingTotalStake
docs: Remaining total amount of staked tokens (cumulative)

fields.name: expiryTs
docs: Time when stake pool expires, staking is not possible after expiration

fields.name: autoUnstake
docs: Whether auto unstaking is enabled, stake entries will be unstaked after duration

fields.name: buffer
docs: Buffer for additional fields

fields.name: mintAuthority
docs: Optional authority used to mint new tokens. The mint authority may only
be provided during mint creation. If no mint authority is present
then the mint has a fixed supply and no further tokens may be minted.

fields.name: supply
docs: Total supply of tokens.

fields.name: decimals
docs: Number of base 10 digits to the right of the decimal place.

fields.name: isInitialized
docs: Is `true` if this structure has been initialized.

fields.name: freezeAuthority
docs: Optional authority to freeze token accounts.
